comparison.objective: Open a stiff sliding window using its fragile handle.
comparison.physical_skill: Regulate pulling speed and force through a delicate handle against velocity-dependent sash resistance.
comparison.success_condition: At least 15 cm of handle-mediated opening without handle detachment or frame/glass damage.
comparison.reason: Although both penalize excessive force, this tests sustained low-force sliding through a fragile handle, not a deliberate calibrated impact that fractures a notched tang.
